note: Expected values are frozen, hand-reviewed control points. These are plain transverse-mercator conversions with no datum-shift grids involved, so they are deterministic across PROJ versions. A mismatch beyond tolerance is a hard error: the layer must refuse to trust its transformation engine, not adjust the reference.
tolerance_note: Forward checks: metres, tolerance 0.001 m (mm-level frozen values). Round-trip check: degrees, tolerance 1e-7 (closure of a full forward+inverse cycle).

transformations.name: riyadh_utm38n_to_wgs84_roundtrip
transformations.place: Riyadh round-trip closure: forward then inverse must return the original point
